project_name: Agricultural Field Carbon Credit Estimation using coupling of Satellite Embeddings and RAG
description: A provisional Sentinel-2 L2A burn-scar screening heuristic. It is not a trained crop classifier or a verified stubble-burning detector.
limitations: The threshold is a screening parameter and is not locally calibrated against Haryana field observations.
A possible burn-scar signal does not prove crop-residue burning.
Failure to detect a signal does not prove that burning did not occur.
No crop class, emissions reduction, or carbon-credit eligibility is predicted.
